service_listing.title: {service} for {audience}
sections:
## What I can deliver
A clear, carefully edited {service}. Agree on the exact scope and format before starting.

## How it works
1. Share the material and requirements.
2. Confirm the scope, deadline, and any revisions in writing.
3. Review the finished draft before delivery.

## Next step
Invite the reader to ask a question or request a small sample. Do not claim experience, results, or credentials you cannot substantiate.

social_post.title: Draft social post: {topic}
sections: I am exploring a practical way to help {audience} with {topic}.
The first step is to keep the scope small, agree on what is included, and deliver a useful draft that the customer can review.
If this would help you, tell me what format or problem matters most. I will share only examples and claims I can verify.

article_outline.title: Draft outline: {topic}
sections:
## Problem to explain
Describe the reader's specific question about {topic}.

## Outline
1. State the problem in plain language.
2. Explain the available options and their trade-offs.
3. Give a short, practical example.
4. List what should be checked before acting.

## Research to add before publishing
Add current, reliable sources and verify every factual or time-sensitive claim.
